Daniel 7:5: After her there was another beast with the likeness of a bear. It stood on one side and had three ribs in its mouth. He spoke in this way: ‘Rise, devour much flesh!’
Daniel 11:6: At the completion of years he will lead them, and the king of Egypt will enter the northern kingdom to make treaties. He will not prevail, for his arm will not establish strength; his arm and that of those traveling with him will grow numb, and he will remain until the appointed hours.
Daniel 11:44: A report from the east and north will disturb him, and he will go out in strong anger and with a sword to wipe out and kill many.
